title: A Provision for the Current
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Ivo Sandoval, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
